This page runs the directory written by [Prepare](prepare.qmd). It does not
change the model or the settings. To change anything, go back to Prepare and
write a new run directory.

::: {.callout-note title="Before you start"}
- The run directory `.artifacts/SimplePad/pad-capacitance-01` from Prepare.
- A computer with Palace. See
  [Install SCGSim, Step 5](../../course/installation.qmd#step-5-set-up-the-solver-host).
- Allow about 30 minutes on 8 MPI processes.
:::

## Step 1: Run Palace

If Palace runs on another computer, copy the **whole** run directory there
first. On the Palace computer, from the run directory:

```bash
cd .artifacts/SimplePad/pad-capacitance-01
bash run_palace.sh
```

The script first checks the configuration with `palace --dry-run`, then
solves.

## Step 2: Return the directory

If Palace ran on another computer, copy the whole directory back, including
`metadata/` and the logs. A results file on its own cannot be loaded.

For Slurm, MPI wrappers and failed runs, see
[Run a prepared model](../../course/execute.qmd).
